pretreatments.description: Microwave pretreatment (MP) performed without the addition of surfactant, using an IFB-30SC2 microwave oven at 900 W and 2450 MHz frequency for treatment times ranging from 1 to 60 minutes.

Sodium dodecylbenzene sulfonate (SDBS) microwaved pretreatment (SMP) performed in the presence of SDBS at concentrations ranging from 0.005 g/g TS to 0.5 g/g TS, utilizing the same microwave conditions as MP.
Control treatment (without pretreatment) where no microwave irradiation or surfactant was applied to the fresh kelp samples prior to the fermentation process.
